{{Quote|The magnetar rifles were specifically designed to disrupt energy shields. The technology's experimental, but effective.|Warden Graal|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Magnetar rifles''' were experimental [[Disruptor rifle/Legends|disruptor rifles]] developed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that were specifically designed to disrupt [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shields]]. A supply of such rifles was kept in the armory of the secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] a gang of prisoners known as the [[Condemned]] broke into the armory to collect weapons and use them against the [[Prison Administration Center]]. [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Graal]] then sent a Republic-aligned individual to recover the magnetar rifles, as they couldn't risk the prisoners getting hold of them.
